lead: `python tools/check-migration.py --seed` is a candidate list, not rows to paste.
body: It attributes every backticked PHP name on a line to whatever that line is *about*, so a member's own prose drags its neighbours in (`acos` → `Core\Math::asin`), and a right member name against the wrong PHP function passes the checker silently. Fill a domain the other way round: read `01-core-library.md`'s table for the class once, then write one row per name `--report` still lists.
